messages:
anna-partnerships: Heads-up: APAC livestream w/ CloudWave + BoltAI next Thu 10am SGT. Need mic ops, live captions (ENG+ZH), merch handoff at venue, and run order. Who's owning run order & kit inventory?

jordan-events: I'll own run order + speaker cue times. @diego-ops can you confirm AV vendor & mics? I'll post draft by EOD.

diego-ops: AV vendor confirmed: NexusAV. Single speaker lav + backup handheld. They need final run by Tue. Also need stage labels and spare batteries.

meera-evangelist: I'll coordinate captions. Need 2-hour pre-record check with translator for ZH. Can we get speaker slides 24h before for captions prep?

sam-courier: Merch ETA: 1 pallet arriving Wed 5pm local. Need recipient on site. I can do last-mile handoff if someone meets courier.

anna-partnerships: ```
09:45 load in + mic check
09:55 speaker intros
10:00 keynote CloudWave (15)
10:20 BoltAI demo (12)
10:35 panel Q&A (20)
10:55 closing + merch pickup
```

jordan-events: Perfect — I'll route speaker bio + slides request. @meera-evangelist add translator contact? Also need merch table coords.

meera-evangelist: Translator is Li Wei (liwei@boltai). I'll schedule 30m call Tue 11am SGT. Can we get slides by Wed 10am SGT?

diego-ops: Noted re batteries & spare handheld. NexusAV requests a stage layout — I can send floor plan. Also confirm streaming key — @deploy-bot can you create a time-limited key?

deploy-bot: Stream key created: live_381234 for session 2026-04-02T10:00:00+08:00. Expires 2026-04-02T13:00:00+08:00. Assigned to channel partnerships.

anna-partnerships: Sam, can you meet courier Wed 5:30pm? Jordan, I'll drop merch table coord in #events floorplans. Also budget for 2 translators?

sam-courier: Can do Wed 5:30pm. Pls DM delivery contact.

jordan-events: I'll allocate budget for one translator + captioning service. If CloudWave covers BoltAI translator, we can re-allocate.

meera-evangelist: :thumbsup: I'll draft captioning handoff doc and speaker captions checklist.

anna-partnerships: Awesome. Quick action items: Jordan: run + speaker cue (EOD). Diego: send stage layout (tomorrow). Meera: schedule translator call (Tue 11am). Sam: courier meet (Wed 5:30). I'll confirm merch table coords and post final run Tue noon. Thanks!

jordan-events: Got it.
